articles.author: Chandelis Duster
articles.title: Multiple people dead as flooding continues in Indiana - NPR
articles.description: Some parts of Indiana received more than 11 inches of rainfall over three days, beginning Aug. 11, causing record floods. Several suburbs of Indianapolis also underwater.
